Sanjay Rao: Quick heads-up: we rolled v3-quant8 to 5% on chat/compose and there's a subtle, persistent drift on a couple signals over ~36h. Not a big spike but trending. Sharing raws and asking for gate ideas.
Amy Chen: Do you have counts and whether it's only this route?
Sanjay Rao: Single route (chat/compose). Last 36h vs baseline: 
`````
requests: 18,240 -> 19,980 (+9.6%)
hallucination_rate: 1.8% -> 2.5% (abs +0.7pp, rel +39%)
embed_cos_sim_mean: 0.82 -> 0.797 (delta -0.023)
95th_token_latency: 210ms -> 238ms (+13.3%)
samples_used_for_metrics: ~4.6k
`````
Small-ish sample but sustained. A/B shows consistent deltas; hallucination p-value ~0.04.
Marco Diaz: This reads like slow drift not a fluke. I don't want an immediate full rollback. Proposal: dual-signal gate (semantic + perf) with hysteresis and staged traffic steps.
Marco Diaz: Gate concept TL;DR:
- Condition A (semantic): embed mean drop >= 0.015 OR hallucination rel increase >= 20%
- Condition B (perf): p95 token latency rel increase >= 10%
- Actions:
  - If A && B sustained >=12h AND samples >=1000 -> auto rollback to pinned variant
  - If (A OR B) for 6-12h with samples between 500-1000 -> cut traffic by 50% + page oncall
  - Apply smoothing: exponential decay alpha=0.2 to avoid flipping on noisy batches
Devon Patel: Agree. Add distribution-shift checks (KL divergence of token distribution) + bootstrap CI on hallucination. Gate config (illustrative):
`````
rollout_gate:
  semantic:
    halluci_rel_thresh: 0.20
    embed_delta_thresh: 0.015
  perf:
    p95_rel_thresh: 0.10
  windows:
    sustained_hours: 12
    min_samples: 1000
    smoothing_alpha: 0.2
  actions:
    on_both: rollback
    on_one_low_sample: reduce_traffic 0.5
`````
Amy Chen: How do we handle low-volume endpoints where min_samples=1000 is unattainable? We could miss regressions there.
Sanjay Rao: For low-volume routes: use longer windows + lower absolute sample threshold but require larger relative effect (to avoid noise). Example: min_samples=200 but sustained_hours=48 and halluci_rel_thresh >=30% or KL >0.07.
Devon Patel: Also compute embed cosine percentiles (p10/p50/p90) instead of only mean; tails can cause user-visible regressions while the mean stays OK.
Marco Diaz: Add an early-warning tier: if p-value <0.1 but not <0.05 -> alert humans (no auto action). Ladder of responses: notice -> reduce -> rollback.
Sanjay Rao: I'll run a shadow/replay for another 24-48h with bootstrap and post results. I'll also push a gate JSON to rollout repo for Console visualization. Example payload (for review):
`````
{
  "name": "signalized_slow_drift_gate_v1",
  "semantic_halluci_rel": "0.20",
  "semantic_embed_delta": "0.015",
  "perf_p95_rel": "0.10",
  "minsamples": "1000",
  "sustained_hours": "12",
  "smoothing_alpha": "0.2",
  "actions_on_both": "rollback",
  "actions_on_one_low_sample": "halve"
}
`````
Amy Chen: Good. Include historical replay test vectors and an FP-rate estimate before enabling auto-rollback.
CI Bot: rollback-policy-lint: OK (syntax). Recommend: run historical-replay test on prod-samples.
Devon Patel: I'll run a 3-month historical replay overnight and compute expected FPR for the gate and the mean time to trigger under simulated drifts.
Marco Diaz: Add a human-override window (30m) so oncall can pause an automated rollback while investigating.
Sanjay Rao: Plan: replays tonight, post simulation numbers in this thread, then enable gate in passive (alerts-only) mode for 48h before switching to staged auto actions. Will also include test vectors + console visualization. Thanks :thumbsup:
